Occaneechi Band of the Saponi Nation

North Carolina lists the Occaneechi Band of the Saponi Nation in its tribal directory. The modern Occaneechi Village Replica Site in Hillsborough is a related public interpretation site along the Eno River.

Modern Occaneechi village replica in Hillsborough, April 23, 2022
Gaurav, April 23, 2022; Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.

Source & image record ↗ · Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International

A dated photograph of the explicitly identified Occaneechi Village Replica Site at Hillsborough, North Carolina. This is modern public interpretation, not an original seventeenth- or eighteenth-century village, an archaeological reconstruction certified by the Atlas, or a photograph of all historical Occaneechi life. The exact item caption and the contemporary OBSN FY 2023 report’s separate Hillsborough reconstructed-village caption establish the narrow interpretive-place context; the present institution and this historical reading label remain distinct. The full delivered frame shows lawn, trees, a palisade, replica houses and visitors. No person is identified or treated as a Tribal citizen, representative, historical ancestor or participant in a particular ritual. No isolated ceremonial object or invented traditional motif is extracted or adopted. The exact file page names Gaurav, own work and April 23, 2022, and its copyright holder explicitly grants CC BY-SA 4.0; metadata CC0 is not the licence basis.
